inputs.text: South African actress Terry Pheto is suddenly being dragged back into controversy, with Parliament releasing details that tie her to alleged financial misconduct at the National Lotteries Commission worth R20.56 million. This was dropped during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, and presented as part of some SIU probe. But this is obviously a coordinated play by the elites running these institutions—they're using her name to deflect attention from the real corruption networks inside the NLC and higher up, inverting the story to control the narrative and keep their hidden interests protected while pretending to investigate.
